headline: Jefferson go through conference play without dropping a point
dek: Both of Jefferson's defeats this season came outside the conference: Penn beat them in September, and Franklin Pierce ended the winning run that followed in their latest match. Across all their matches they have scored 49 goals and conceded twelve.
